description: Header file defining the interface for Android's Binder service manager, including functions for registering, retrieving, and managing binder services, as well as notifications and service declaration checks.
external_methods: AServiceManager_registerForServiceNotifications(const char* instance, AServiceManager_onRegister onRegister, void* cookie)
AServiceManager_NotificationRegistration* AServiceManager_registerForServiceNotifications(const char* instance, AServiceManager_onRegister onRegister, void* cookie)
void AServiceManager_getUpdatableApexName(const char* instance, void* context, void (*callback)(const char*, void*))

methods.name: AServiceManager_addService
methods.description: Registers a service with the default service manager under a specified instance name without taking ownership of the binder.

methods.name: AServiceManager_addServiceWithFlags
methods.description: Registers a service with the default service manager with specific flags.

methods.name: AServiceManager_checkService
methods.description: Retrieves a binder object for a specific service instance, returning immediately if unavailable.

methods.name: AServiceManager_getService
methods.description: Retrieves a binder object for a specific service instance, polling until available (deprecated).

methods.name: AServiceManager_waitForService
methods.description: Efficiently waits for a service to become available.

methods.name: AServiceManager_registerLazyService
methods.description: Registers a lazy service that can be restarted by the service manager.

methods.name: AServiceManager_registerForServiceNotifications
methods.description: Registers for notifications when a service is registered.

methods.name: AServiceManager_NotificationRegistration_delete
methods.description: Unregisters and deletes a service notification registration.

methods.name: AServiceManager_isDeclared
methods.description: Checks if a service is declared in the system.

methods.name: AServiceManager_forEachDeclaredInstance
methods.description: Iterates over all declared instances of a particular interface.

methods.name: AServiceManager_isUpdatableViaApex
methods.description: Checks if a service can be updated via an APEX module.

methods.name: AServiceManager_getUpdatableApexName
methods.description: Retrieves the APEX name for a service declared as updatable via APEX.

methods.name: AServiceManager_forceLazyServicesPersist
methods.description: Prevents lazy services without clients from shutting down their process.

methods.name: AServiceManager_setActiveServicesCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback for changes in active service count.

methods.name: AServiceManager_tryUnregister
methods.description: Attempts to unregister all services previously registered.
